title: Use a non-html tag as the default highlighting tag

comments.body:
If I try to wrap my head around this, we want to avoid doing a regex? Or do we want to use dangerouslySetInnerHTML?

What is the underlying issue we want to solve? (not the implementation, the current bad effect we want to solve)

I'm still not convinced by the use of the timestamp, it adds entropy for sure, but for what? 
Why don't we go with static pre/post tag easier to replace and to reason about.

React InstantSearch has been moved here: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch
This issue has either been rewritten or placed inside our backlog.
